column1: # Stream npcanim (TOP50 round 4): per-creature ATTACK and BLOCK animations, as data.
# A row ships only where TWO independent sources name the same weapon family:
#   1. cache - the creature's own 950 definition carries parameter 2816, which the cache's own
#              parameter TYPE table (index 2, group 11, opcode 101 -> ScriptVarType id 73 STRUCT)
#              declares to be a struct reference. That struct carries parameter 2914, which the
#              same table types ANIMATION (ScriptVarType id 6), and 2917 likewise. 2914/2917 are
#              the attack and block sequences this server ALREADY reads for player weapons -
#              Native950MeleeWeapons.java:69-70, and the same pair for ranged, magic and
#              necromancy weapons and for spell structs. The struct ids are the shipped weapon
#              families of resources/native950/melee-weapons-950.tsv (14921 dagger, 14923 sword,
#              14929 battleaxe, 14932 halberd, 14933 maul, 14935 whip, 14937 staff, 14939/14940
#              bow, 14941 crossbow). The NPC definition, the struct and both sequence definitions
#              are SHA-256 pinned in npcanim-950.properties and re-read at startup.
#   2. wiki   - the RS3 wiki names, on the creature's own page, the weapon the creature carries,
#              and the cache item of exactly that name carries the SAME struct in its own
#              parameter 686. The quoted evidence is in the row.
# Every other creature keeps -1 and swings silently, exactly as before. In particular all ten
# id the live capture shows the user fighting at the Varrock stone circle) carry no animation-typed
# and no struct-typed parameter at all, their BAS (2699 for the 172 group, 2698 for 8871-8874)
# publishes only stand/walk/run, and the wiki publishes no animation id, so there is nothing to ship
# for them. Three UNPLACED definitions also named "Dark wizard" - 29292, 29293 elder, 29294 master -
# do name struct 14938; nothing is shipped for them either. See reports/r4-npcanim-2026-09-21.md.
# Every creature in this table is a MELEE-REACH creature (attackStyle MELEE, attackRange 1). Falador
# guards 3229/3231/3232/3233 deal RANGED-typed damage but still walk into contact to do it, because
# nothing on this revision publishes a per-creature reach. No creature that attacks the player from
# a distance gains an animation from this table.
# Recorded disagreement (brief rule: record both): Speedy Keith's own parameter 2816 is the 14940
# chargebow struct while the wiki's named strykebow (item 34158) carries struct 14939. Both
# structs publish the SAME attack sequence 37462 and the same block 18295, so the shipped number
# is identical either way; the creature's own struct is the one used.
